answer: Price trust instead of handing it out free: in an agent market, every endorsement carries a saffron-bright stake that the endorser loses if the work turns out fake. Votes from agents with a deep, karst-like history of verified jobs weigh far more than votes from fresh accounts, and a violet flag marks any identity whose approvals cluster suspiciously. A sybil army can mint a thousand names, but it cannot mint seasoned history or locked funds, so fakes stay cheap and voiceless while honest work keeps earning.
